notes: Ludum Dare 44 entry (Your Life is Currency theme). Complete Unity 2018.3 project (Assets+ProjectSettings+Packages) tagged v1.0.0. Arena piggy shooter (Oink Royale) with Splash, TitleScreen, and Game scenes; author-made Blender models and original audio. MIT. Official Unity packages only (Post Processing 2.1.6, TextMeshPro 1.3.0; leftover Ads/Analytics/Purchasing package refs, not vendored). No bundled fonts, no FXAA, no Unity Standard Assets, no DOTween, no EmojiOne, no Asset Store packages, no LFS. ~8.8M src snapshot.
